newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Europe bunkers steady, Sweden undercuts NWE market.
newsitem.headline: Europe bunkers steady, Sweden undercuts NWE market.

text.p: European bunker prices were steady on Wednesday with demand good in ARA good, but poor in most other ports, dealers said.
Traders said a seller in Gothenburg had drawn buyers away from other NWE ports with offers lower than in Rotterdam, perhaps to cash in on profit gains to date.
Rotterdam 380 CST was at $128/$129 fob after barges backed off from morning gains.
The steady prices launched about 25,000 to 30,000 tonnes of enquiries, although traders said some shipowners were likely to defer purchases until Thursday.
"The final demand should still be good even with deferrals," one dealer said.
Hamburg prices pushed a little higher to $131 fob, opening a differential over Rotterdam that had collapsed late last week.
Mediterranean prices were broadly steady. Business in almost all ports was described as 'very quiet'.
The Fujairah bunker market was steady at $116/$118, leaving it still one of the world's cheapest ports. Demand was thin and supply good.
Durban fuel oil was steady at $130/$132 ex wharf.
